Veteran Warrior Ma'athal is a githyanki Veteran Warrior who attempts to ambush the party near the Road to Baldur's Gate in Reithwin Town within the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Involvement

If the party are marked for death by  Vlaakith,  Ch'r'ai Tska'an, Ma'athal, and the rest of their unit lie in wait to ambush them as they approach the western gate to Reithwin Town. Carrying the  Qua'nith Psionic Detector allows the party to spot the ambush and surprise them instead.
